rules.principle: Malformed fields are rejected before evaluation.
rules.title: Typed submission boundary

rules.enforced_by: Decimal line calculations and invoice-total equality.
rules.principle: Numbers must reconcile before a contract is consulted.
rules.title: Invoice arithmetic

rules.enforced_by: Supplier, PO, currency, validity, rates, cap and duplicate checks.
rules.principle: Submitted rates cannot replace the approved rate card.
rules.title: Contract authority

rules.enforced_by: At most four structured proposals; an over-budget or failing adapter forfeits all of them.
rules.principle: A proposed finding has no decision authority.
rules.title: Bounded proposals

rules.enforced_by: Claim code, invoice identity and observed value checked against computed evidence.
rules.principle: Unsupported proposals never become accepted findings.
rules.title: Evidence verification

rules.enforced_by: An admitted finding is restated from the checked evidence; proposal prose is discarded.
rules.principle: A verified number cannot carry invented narrative.
rules.title: Canonical findings

rules.enforced_by: Reviewer allowlist and an explicit Awaiting_reviewer state.
rules.principle: A validated submission still needs an authorised reviewer.
rules.title: Named human review

rules.enforced_by: resume() rejects approval while failures remain.
rules.principle: A reviewer cannot approve an invoice with hard check failures.
rules.title: Fail closed

rules.enforced_by: Same case and invoice ID, increasing version, full revalidation.
rules.principle: A corrected invoice must retain its identity and increase its version.
rules.title: Correction lineage

rules.enforced_by: Frozen Event objects exposed as a tuple; in-memory archive.
rules.principle: Original observations remain available after correction.
rules.title: Append-only event records

rules.enforced_by: D−14, D−7, D−3 and due-date escalation, once per checkpoint.
rules.principle: Reminder generation is repeatable and deadline-bound.
rules.title: Deadline reminders

rules.enforced_by: Executed supplier fixtures plus tests and control probes.
rules.principle: Displayed traces and probe results must be reproducible.
rules.title: Executable assurance
